name: Celestial Quill Library
description: An infinite library where books are written with quills that draw constellations; each page turn reshapes the night sky.
prompt: Grand library hall with towering shelves. Floating quills made of light write glowing constellations on open books. Pages turn, altering a projected star map on the ceiling. Ethereal glow, high detail, 8k.
caption: Write your own cosmos, one page at a time. 🖋️🌌 #CelestialQuillLibrary
